title: Philips Hue Bridge HomeKit Pair-Setup Default Password Authentication Bypass Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-126977)
description: A vulnerability in the Philips Hue Bridge HomeKit Authentication service allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication without credentials. The flaw exists in the service listening on TCP port 8080, where crafted pairing requests can authenticate using a blank password. This enables unauthorized access to the affected device.
